corrections.withdrawn_wording: odd-half Parseval identity ... over all count tuples
corrections.actual_execution: The parent iterated candidate n1,n3,n5 in range(0,257,16), i.e. multiples of 16 from 0 through 256 (17^3 candidate triples before filtering), skipped n1+n3+n5>256 and cases whose energy was not divisible by 64, and reported odd_parseval_identity=true on the remaining grid. It was not an exhaustive check of all counts.
corrections.additional_current_reasoning: Separately, the universal identity follows algebraically from n1+n3+n5+n7=256 and 64(256-m)=n1+9n3+25n5+49n7. Eliminating n7 gives 64m-3840=48n1+40n3+24n5, hence 8(m-60)=6n1+5n3+3n5. This is a new written reconstruction, not a claim that the old grid was exhaustive.

corrections.actual_execution: The parent used the first 400 terms of the geometric series and reported the floating rendering of its exact-Fraction difference from 571/66 as -6.128873182200827e-112. It did not establish the infinite-series equality by that numerical test. The frozen f238 disposition already says reproduced to the series precision used.
corrections.additional_current_reasoning: Separately, for a geometric index I with b=1/2, E[I], E[I^2], E[I^3], E[I^4] are 1,3,13,75. Substitution in the reviewed octagon polynomials gives E[A(I)]=11 and E[M(I)]=571/6, hence J=571/66. This written calculation is new and does not change the chronology of the earlier truncation.
